name: Arnaud Dressen
title: Founder
bio: Arnaud is the CEO and founder of , a cutting-edge web platform focused on immersive learning. Wonda Driven by a passion for using technology to enhance human creativity and foster collaboration, Arnaud has spent more than two decades at the forefront of media and education. His previous achievements include the creation of one of the first community-driven investigative journalism platforms, supported by the United Nations and the Ford Foundation, and pioneering innovative interactive documentaries featured at SXSW and the Cannes Film Festival. Arnaud's recent endeavors with Wonda have been focused on providing educators with innovative tools to facilitate the teaching and learning of vital 21st-century skills by leveraging the power of spatial computing and generative AI. His work, in collaboration with leading universities and creative studios, has earned Wonda recognition as one of the top 8 XR education startups by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.
